en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5326 - In the narration of Al-Sakuni,

it is reported that a man was brought to Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) who had trampled on another man's stomach until he defecated in his clothes. Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) ruled:
"His stomach should be trampled until he defecates as the victim did, or he must pay one-third of the blood money (diyyah)."
